text: BAM share rose 0.14 percentage points over 27 hours and 1.68 percentage points over 7 days, putting BAM at 37.5% of all Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 27% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 66 top-node leadership changes in this window are best read as whale-driven routing, not structural rollover evidence.
